# Description list

Term and value pairs: the properties of a run, a document or an evaluation.

Status: Stable. Semantic versioning applies: nothing breaks without a deprecation first.

Term and value pairs: the properties panel of every run, document and rollout. Three layouts for three reading tasks — **inline** for a side panel scanned top to bottom, **stacked** for values long enough to wrap, **grid** for a summary closing a section. Values marked `literal` are set in the machine face so an id is never mistaken for prose.

## Usage

### When to use

- A side panel of properties scanned top to bottom, with the inline layout.
- Values long enough to wrap, such as a system prompt or a path, with the stacked layout.
- A summary that closes a section, with the grid layout.
- Ids, hashes and model names marked literal, so they are never read as prose.

### When not to

- Many records with the same fields, compared row against row. Use [Table](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-table--overview.md).
- A few headline figures with their change over time. Use [Stat](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-stat--overview.md).
- The fields of a record before and after a proposed change. Use [FieldChanges](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-change-review--overview.md).

### Do and don’t

- Do: Mark ids and model strings literal, and leave prose and figures in the system voice.
- Don’t: Set every value in the monospace.

### Content

- Terms are short nouns in sentence case, without colons: “Model”, “Duration”.
- Give values their units, “41s”, “$0.2185”, and show a status as a Badge rather than a bare word.

## API

### `DescriptionList` (component)

- `layout`: `inline`, `stacked`, `grid` (default `inline`)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (required) | `DescriptionItem[]` |  |  |
| `layout` | `"inline" \| "stacked" \| "grid"` | `inline` |  |

`className`, `ref`, `id` and the other DOM props go to `<dl data-slot="description-list">`.

### `descriptionListVariants` (function)

Types: `DescriptionItem`, `DescriptionListProps`

## Accessibility

Nothing in it takes focus, so there is no keyboard table.

### Mola handles

- Renders a real `<dl>` with each `<dt>` and `<dd>` pair grouped in a `<div>`, so terms and values are read together.
- Sets values marked `literal` in the machine face, so an id is not mistaken for prose.

### You handle

- Write terms as short nouns, and keep each value to the fact it names.
- Put a heading above the list; it has no name of its own.

### Testing status

- Automated, jsdom: each of its 3 stories is rendered and checked with axe on every pull request.
- Automated, browser: every story is checked in Chromium with axe, colour contrast included, in both themes, and for overflow at 390px.
- Keyboard in unit tests: not applicable.
- Screen readers: not yet tested by hand.
